```{ojs}
//| label: live-poll-helpers
//| echo: false
// Helpers for the live version (polls, surveys, math); a deck includes this file once, on a
// slide inside ::: {.content-visible when-profile="live"}. It needs
// poll_base from R: if (live) ojs_define(poll_base = poll_base)
QRCode = require("qrcode-generator@1.4.4")

function pollLink(id, choices) {
  return `${poll_base}/?poll=${id}&choices=${encodeURIComponent(choices.join(","))}`;
}

function surveyLink(id) {
  return `${poll_base}/survey?id=${id}`;
}

// QR code with the link written below, for the students' phones
function qrCode(link, label = link, size = 320) {
  const qr = QRCode(0, "M");
  qr.addData(link);
  qr.make();
  return html`<div style="text-align: center">
    <img src="${qr.createDataURL(8, 2)}" style="width: ${size}px; image-rendering: pixelated">
    <div style="font-size: 0.6em; word-break: break-all">${label}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function pollQR(id, choices) {
  return qrCode(pollLink(id, choices), `${poll_base}/?poll=${id}`);
}

function surveyQR(id, size = 420) {
  return qrCode(surveyLink(id), surveyLink(id), size);
}

// JSON from the poll service, fetched again every 3 seconds; null if eumel
// cannot be reached
function fetchEvery3s(link) {
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    let timer;
    const update = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(link, {cache: "no-store"});
        notify(response.ok ? await response.json() : null);
      } catch (error) {
        notify(null);
      }
      timer = setTimeout(update, 3000);
    };
    update();
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  });
}

function pollAnswers(id) {
  return fetchEvery3s(`${poll_base}/data?poll=${id}`);
}

function surveyResults(id) {
  return fetchEvery3s(`${poll_base}/survey/data?id=${id}`);
}

// Bar chart of a multiple-choice poll in the order of `choices`
function pollBars(answers, choices) {
  if (answers === null) return md`*Cannot reach the poll on eumel.*`;
  const counts = choices.map(choice => ({
    choice,
    n: answers.filter(d => d.value === choice).length
  }));
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 620,
    height: 400,
    marginLeft: 210,
    style: {fontSize: "18px"},
    x: {label: null, domain: [0, Math.max(5, ...counts.map(d => d.n))]},
    y: {label: null, domain: choices},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(counts, {x: "n", y: "choice", fill: "#901A1E"}),
      Plot.text(counts, {x: "n", y: "choice", text: "n", dx: 14, fontSize: 18}),
      Plot.ruleX([0])
    ]
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}<p style="font-size: 0.7em">Answers so far: ${answers.length}</p></div>`;
}

// One small bar chart per survey question, three per row
function surveyCharts(results) {
  if (results === null) return md`*Cannot reach the survey on eumel.*`;
  const charts = results.questions.map(q => {
    const counts = q.choices.map((choice, i) => ({choice, n: q.counts[i]}));
    return html`<div>
      <div style="font-size: 0.6em; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 10px">${q.short}</div>
      ${Plot.plot({
        width: 340,
        height: 30 + 34 * counts.length,
        marginLeft: 195,
        marginRight: 30,
        style: {fontSize: "14px"},
        x: {axis: null, domain: [0, Math.max(3, ...counts.map(d => d.n))]},
        y: {label: null, domain: q.choices},
        marks: [
          Plot.barX(counts, {x: "n", y: "choice", fill: "#901A1E"}),
          Plot.text(counts, {x: "n", y: "choice", text: "n", dx: 10, fontSize: 14}),
          Plot.ruleX([0])
        ]
      })}
    </div>`;
  });
  return html`<div>
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px 10px">${charts}</div>
    <p style="font-size: 0.6em; margin: 0">Answers so far: ${results.respondents}</p>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: live-math
//| echo: false
// The interactive charts hide KaTeX's global, so Quarto cannot typeset the
// math of the live version. Load KaTeX here and typeset every formula
liveMath = {
  const katex = await require("katex@0.13.11/dist/katex.min.js");
  if (!document.querySelector("link[data-live-katex]")) {
    document.head.append(html`<link rel="stylesheet" data-live-katex
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.13.11/dist/katex.min.css">`);
  }
  for (const element of document.querySelectorAll("span.math")) {
    if (element.querySelector(".katex")) continue;
    katex.render(element.textContent, element, {
      displayMode: element.classList.contains("display"),
      throwOnError: false
    });
  }
  return html`<span></span>`;
}
```
